records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $404.6 million, a decrease of 22.4% from the $521.3 million in the third quarter 2022 and a decrease of 13.4% from the $467.2 million in the second quarter 2023;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit was $155.9 million, a decrease of 28.4% from the $217.8 million in the third quarter 2022 and a decrease of 20.2% from the $195.4 million in the second quarter 2023;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net income attributable to common stockholders was $48.7 million, compared to $86.4 million in the third quarter 2022 and $82.0 million in the second quarter 2023;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit margin was 38.5%, compared to 41.8% in the third quarter 2022 and the second quarter of 2023;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash flows provided by operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2023 was $242.5 million.
